full_results_discussion: K35 RN-JP improves U by 1.900825% against contemporaneous OFF, but weakens supported L by 0.0172169630606 and increases relative gap by 0.971762 percentage points. K20 reaches the same U with a weaker supported L; neither method certifies. RX20 certifies the identical objective in both methods, with no material certificate/total-time benefit. RB35 RN-JP U/L is 0.383702514966/0.220374791101, against OFF 0.344642625592/0.218985949603; its signed changes are delta U=0.0390598893744, delta L=0.00138884149749, and delta relative gap=6.106245 percentage points. All adverse endpoints remain authoritative. The source is active on all four roles, so the new resource endpoint is not explained by the predecessor's no-PC prefix finding.
bridge_discussion: The K35 same-PE old RN-P bridge gives U/L=0.660923637174/0.550645816146 and relative gap 0.166854103598, against RN-JP 0.679684412741/0.541069698488 and 0.203939816266. RN-JP minus RN-P is 0.0187607755676 in U, -0.00957611765793 in supported L, and 3.708571 percentage points in relative gap. Both formal models have zero RN columns and at most one PC. This is a direct finite comparison of the two compact candidates; it is not a causal column-count experiment or a whole-tree preservation test.
decision_paragraph: Retain RN-JP as default-off research and stop this once-root joint-expression trial without stable promotion. The local theorem, stronger real joint LP, exact saved-point separation, full-block projection and near-complete root retention are retained results. They have not yielded a sufficiently convincing complete improvement over BASE across the core roles; the single K35 bridge assesses existing compact RN-P. A stronger paid source followed by one root row does not enforce full integer-objective consistency or guarantee useful descendant search. Do not automatically add more thresholds, repeated separation, floor grids, a second route-A panel, or further seeds. Optional K15/RX35 pairs and Seed/floor controls are not entered: the observed mixed/negative complete evidence already resolves adoption of this candidate, and no specific opposing result currently justifies that cost. Unused budget is not a reason to expand. This closure does not erase the earlier STOCK certificates or RN-P K35 computational gains.
scope: Known finite four-role Seed0 panel, not unseen validation or global dominance
